cases.note: Nails (config.weapons.nailgun): several in flight at once. L0 into enemy 1 (stuck + arsenal status on L0), L1 into enemy 1 (stuck, no status), a nail into the wall (z = -30), a nail into the open air (alive until stepsFor(range / speed)), a kill (enemy 3, hp 5: no stick), a piercing nail (set pierce 2) through enemies 4, 5 and stuck in 6, a homing nail (enemy 7, off the aim line: turned passes config.aim.homingAssistAngle, assisted), an L1 homing nail whose target (8) is killed mid-flight (it flies on straight into the wall); enemy 1 moved, detonate L0 (its stuck nails follow the aim point), detonate L1 (only its own), detonate L0 again (none left: 0); a nail stuck in enemy 9, then killEnemy(9) releases it on the next step; steps until the air nail ends.

Rockets (config.weapons.rocket): L0 into the wall beside a cluster (11, 12 near, 13 at the edge, 14 outside); L1 with radiusMult 1.4 beside a second cluster (22 hit only thanks to the 1.4, 23 outside); L0 with fragments = config.weapons.specials.rocket.variantFragments (steps until every fragment bursts); an L0 rocket at the owner's feet (the knockback impulse + rocketJump); L0 rocket steered (steerRockets(0, point) before each of 40 steps) down onto the floor while an L1 rocket flies on unaffected into the wall; a homing L0 rocket onto enemy 41 and an L1 rocket straight into enemy 42.

Lifetimes: an L0 nail into the open air (dies after stepsFor(range / speed)), an L1 rocket into the open air (explodes where it is after stepsFor(lifetime): no hits, no knockback), and an L0 and an L1 nail stuck in enemy 51 until stepsFor(config.weapons.nailgun.stickTime).

clear(): an L0 nail stuck in enemy 61, an L0 fragments rocket that blasts on the wall (its fragments still pending), an L1 nail and an L1 rocket in flight; clear(), then steps: nothing flies, sticks or bursts.
